children: US semiconductor connectivity firm's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 154% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 beat consensus
Growth driven by high-volume Scorpio fabric switch production
Astera Labs expects Q4 revenue between $730 mln and $750 mln
Company projects Q4 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.13 to $1.17
Astera Labs forecasts Q4 GAAP gross margin of about 72%
SCORPIO SWITCH RAMP - Co said revenue growth was led by high-volume production of Scorpio X-Series fabric switches, which became its largest product family
NEW DESIGN WINS - Co said accelerated design activity and wins across multiple customers and applications contributed to results
PORTFOLIO EXPANSION - Co cited expansion of its product portfolio, including Aries 7, Leo 2 and Leo X-Series, and Orion rack-scale reference architecture, as supporting growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the semiconductors peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Astera Labs, Inc. is $425.00, about 85% above its November 2 closing price of $229.67
The stock recently traded at 38 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 79 three months ago
